data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content: Loaded with fresh blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, these scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch. Recipe includes step-by-step instructions and baking tips.
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Loaded with fresh blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, these scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

result.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Loaded with fresh blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, these scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

result.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Loaded with fresh blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, these scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

**Blueberry Scones Recipe**

These scones are loaded with fresh blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, perfect for breakfast or brunch.

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
10. Cool slightly before serving.

Blueberry Scones

Loaded with fresh blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, these scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.
